subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Urban Air Mobility
description: A 60-second lesson on Urban Air Mobility.

hook.text: Imagine skipping a 90-minute traffic jam by hopping on a 15-minute air taxi across the city.

buildup.text: Urban air mobility envisions networks of vertiports on rooftops, parking garages, and transit hubs.

discovery.text: Passengers would book flights via an app, arrive at a vertiport, and fly to their destination on a schedule.

twist.text: The challenge is noise—even quiet eVTOLs would be unpopular buzzing over residential neighborhoods constantly.

climax.text: Dubai and Singapore are building the first vertiport networks, aiming for commercial service within years.

punchline.text: Air taxis need more than technology—they need cities that welcome them.

quiz.question: What is a major challenge for urban air mobility adoption?
options: Insufficient battery power for long flights
